d: A set of polished silver metallic gauntlets and articulated finger plates, layered over dark charcoal fabric with ruffled cuffs. A long, slender silver sword with a gold-accented crossguard and the word "AURANAAA" engraved vertically on the blade, featuring streaks of deep crimson blood along the lower edge. The equipment is draped over and intertwined with heavy, tattered folds of matte black fabric.
